## Audit Report

### Objective
Expand the Docusaurus documentation site (`website/docs/`) by: (1) creating a render-pipeline architecture page, (2) splitting the cookbook into separate recipe files, (3) adding surveying-specific cookbook recipes for ICP registration and volume calculation, (4) expanding GL plugin authoring details, and (5) updating the sidebar navigation. Validate with `npm run build` inside `website/`.

### Evidence Review

| Requirement | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 1. render-pipeline.md | ✅ | `website/docs/architecture/render-pipeline.md` exists with 230+ lines covering FBO pipeline, painter's algorithm, LOD levels, EDL/SSAO shaders, stereo rendering modes, and 2D overlay system. |
| 2. Cookbook split | ✅ | 14 individual recipe `.md` files found: `icp`, `point-pairs`, `cloud-to-cloud-distance`, `cloud-to-mesh-distance`, `crop`, `subsample`, `cross-section`, `volume-25d`, `scalar-field-colors`, `measurement`, `screenshot`, `batch-cli`, `merge`, `save-session`. `cookbook/index.md` is a clean TOC pointing to all 14. |
| 3. Surveying recipes | ✅ | `icp.md` covers fine ICP registration with random sampling limits, overlap settings, and gotchas. `volume-25d.md` covers 2.5D volume with rasterize-first workflow for true 3D piles. `cloud-to-cloud-distance.md` and `point-pairs.md` provide complementary surveying registration content. |
| 4. GL plugin authoring | ✅ | `plugins/gl.md` (140+ lines) documents the GL plugin interface, CC_DRAW_CONTEXT, qEDL example with shader passes, and when to use GL vs. Standard. `plugins/authoring.md` (190+ lines) covers full plugin lifecycle: template copy, renaming, CMake wiring, CI integration, and debugging. |
| 5. Sidebar navigation | ✅ | `sidebars.js` contains all 14 cookbook pages under a "Cookbook" category and `architecture/render-pipeline` under "Architecture". |
| 6. Build validation | ✅ | `npm run build` in `website/` exits successfully with `[SUCCESS] Generated static files in "build"` and zero errors. |

### Quality Assessment
All five deliverables contain substantive, reader-facing content with code examples, tables, prerequisites, gotchas, and cross-links. The cookbook recipes are not stubs — each averages 50–100 lines with actionable steps and context. The render-pipeline page is a genuine architectural deep-dive. No evidence of scaffold-only or placeholder content.

### Conclusion
All explicit requirements are satisfied and verifiable. The build succeeds.

<approved/>
